data.explanation: This is an invoice from a piano repair company for tuning and mechanical repair work done on your piano. You need to pay the total amount shown by the deadline shown, transferring it to the bank account given on the invoice, ideally quoting the invoice number as reference. The letter does not mention what happens if you pay late, but it's good practice to pay on time to avoid a reminder or late fees. No other action is required unless you disagree with the charges, in which case you should contact the company directly.
